notes:
- Sir Chonk: every second Le Chonk round, the boss arrives: a huge Le Chonk in a tuxedo, top hat,
  monocle and curled moustache. Slow and tough (boss health bar at the top), and every 6 s he summons
  two fast Mini Chonks. Beating him gives everyone 500 points and drops Double Points and Max Ammo.
- Detailed props on all three maps: about 65 new voxel models replace the old coloured blocks.
  Prison: mess tables with stools, washing machines, hospital beds with IV stands, guard desks with CRT
  monitors, lockers, pews, shower walls, bunk beds and toilets in the cells, gym gear. Outskirts: cars
  and pickups, street lamps, mailboxes, hydrants, dumpsters, trees and bushes, a fountain, sheds,
  sofas, beds, kitchens, diner booths and counters, stocked store and pharmacy shelves, a car on a lift,
  workbenches, gas pumps. Laboratory: lab benches with glassware, specimen tanks, fume hoods, cryo pods,
  blinking server racks, hazmat lockers, archive shelves, an executive desk, gas cylinders, decon showers.
- Bullet holes: shots leave holes in walls, floors and props (the newest 150 stay).
- Outskirts less open: fences, hedges and low garden walls (each with a gap to walk through) now
  split up many of the streets and yards.
- Main menu: Sir Chonk stares in through a window, and a few Mini Chonks sit about the cell block.
- Change your name in the co-op lobby (updates for everyone) or in Settings.
- Katana toned down: no longer one-hits zombies late on (two hits at round 16, three by round 25).
  The Fire Axe was toned down a little too.
